theorems.name: Submission.rsd_mem_support_iff_measure_ball_pos
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ x : Euclid P, x ∈ T.support ↔ x ∈ U ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → 0 < R.measure (ball x r)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
